controls.candidate_revision_rule: Record the merged #200 candidate SHA, tool/config hashes and both built UI hashes before any scored input is submitted. Use the same finalist revisions for primary and confirmation.

reservation_history.excluded: C04 duplicated the model and Beirut locality in eval/channel_calibration.py at the control revision. C07 replaced it before C07 lookup or any product development. All other original requests were retained.

catalog.digest_recipe: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact, sorted-key JSON (ensure_ascii=False) of [[retailer_id, parsed payload], ...] ordered by retailer_id. Exclude import timestamps.
catalog.reset: Copy the same closed, freshly migrated seed with an empty evidence directory for each arm, case and phase. Start a fresh buyer session. Background collection stays off. Keep the real shared campaign ledger across live runs.

operations: scoped product, selected-variant and policy reads
shared field evidence, freshness and decimal cost checks
general web search by query and channel
interactive retailer browser and pre-order quotes

web_discovery_conditional.tavily: Enable for both arms if the same preflight search succeeds under the approved account and rate. Otherwise record the failure and disable it for both before locking the run.

tools.channel_choice: Either arm can choose a different enabled channel, reformulate a query, or skip search. General discovery can surface sellers outside the starting directory. Search results are leads; apply the shared source review before accessing a new seller.

browser.scope: Use reviewed retailer endpoints and operations, including approved quote steps. Scope navigation, redirects, browser requests and submitted fields. Send precise addresses only to buyer-authorized named sellers for a quote; exclude them from search queries. Preserve an unknown fee when the available input is insufficient. Exclude payment, orders, reservations, seller messages and retailer-account creation.
browser.state: Fresh isolated context per arm and case. Retain the selected variant and destination across actions within the case. Bind each captured result to the selected item, seller, branch or destination, URL and time.
browser.accounting: Meter external browser traffic and provider work through the same source, time, call and spend limits as other tools. Redact addresses and session identifiers from traces and replay keys.

parity.control: Keep the #197 controller as the decision baseline. Integrate the common tools through its existing search and retailer-read paths, including an interactive fallback for missing selected-variant or fulfillment evidence. Record the adapter revision separately from the control revision.
parity.preflight: Before scoring, exercise each required search connector, managed scrape and a state-changing retailer selection or quote from both implementations on development inputs. Require successful general web search and browser interaction in each. Resolve missing required access before scoring; record transient failures during scored runs as outcomes.
run_lock: both runnable revisions and shared adapter revision
effective channel set and provider rates
identical scoped actions, source policy and budgets
development smoke receipts for both arms
parity.replay: Key search responses by provider, query and locale. Key browser observations by seller, URL, prior session state and action with its arguments, including selected variant, quantity and a non-identifying destination reference. Give either arm the same recorded response or explicit miss. Keep replay sessions isolated.

order.case_order: Use each cohort's ids in listed order. Replay primary then confirmation only after the finalist code and evidence bank are locked; reserve confirmation results until both finalists are fixed.
order.pair_execution: Sequential, one accepted original per arm/case/phase. Alternate first arm by position within each cohort. Run the other arm immediately after the shared cooldown. Never feed one arm's discoveries or private history to the other.

scoring.score_from: Normal buyer UI, original submissions only. Keep timeouts, errors, drift and unassessable originals in denominators. Record any later rerun separately.
scoring.confirmation: Report results for all six originals separately from the 20, including per-case evidenced successes, failures and reference gaps. No substitution or pooled release threshold. Verify independently any alternative offer found by either arm.
metrics: exact variant or hard constraints confirmed (UI)
current price and working seller link (UI)
scoring.useful_answer: Count a case once when the UI earns full, useful partial or evidenced blocker credit appropriate to the independent reference. Seller-pair credit is separate. Use all original attempts' cost. Report no ratio if zero useful answers. Show uncertain reservations separately.
scoring.decision: Apply the primary correctness gates before comparing cost and latency. Report replay and live separately; retain paired case outcomes and reference drift. The confirmation set checks generalization.

replaces.change: Shared tool access for both arms; all other experiment conditions are inherited.
